description:
Iona House, a wonderful, unique and spacious period home enjoying outstanding panoramic sea views whilst enjoying the mix of period features with a modern flair.

Having been lovingly transformed into a well-proportioned home with approx. 191.88 sqm (2,065 sq ft) of accommodation overlooking the open green space and seafront at Newtownsmith, a short stroll to Dun Laoghaire’s East Pier, Sandycove and the Forty Foot bathing facility as well as Glasthule with its wine bars, boutiques, restaurants and artisan shops selling a wide and varied produce.

Sandycove & Glasthule Dart Station is close by as are supermarkets in Dun Laoghaire with a cinema, theatre and much, much more all on the doorstep.
The People’s Park which hosts a weekly market is only minutes away as is the famous Teddy’s Ice Cream shop.

There are a number of schools both Primary and Secondary within easy reach, some of these include Castle Park School, The Harold School, Loreto Dalkey, Holy Child Killiney, St Joseph of Cluny, Rathdown School, CBC Monkstown Park, Blackrock College and St Andrew’s College to name only a few so easily accessible to this home.

Accommodation consists of a sitting-room to the front with utility room at this level. There is a hidden door to the bedroom wing which is on the ground floor with three spacious bedrooms, the main bedroom suite includes an ensuite shower room. There is a luxuriously fitted family bathroom at this level.
Within the sitting-room there is a modern staircase to the first allow return with a shower room. Also, at this level there is the open plan kitchen, breakfast room and family room which opens to the private lawned garden approximately 20m long which enjoys a sunny south westerly aspect.

From the first floor return the staircase leads to the dining-room which enjoys elevated sea views. There is also a study at this level.
